question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you expect Sam to break up with Spencer?
Which pair do you like best?

nodes.text: Sam has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Sam squats down into a low stance, blocking Howard!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Whoa!` Nice block, Samface!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color] Nice block, Samface!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Outta my way, Sam! He made $ZOE cry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It wasn't him, Howard! It was Ryan! Keith was just coming back to apologize...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: She's right. I'm sorry, $ZOE. No one deserves to be treated as rudely as I was treating you...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, why'd you stop the show?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Except for maybe one person.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No one makes my girl cry!
Howard starts toward Ryan, but Keith stops him...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't worry, Howard, I'll take care of him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure, Keith?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll just do the same thing we do to any rude customer here at Pico de Salsa...
Later, at the end of a lovely meal... Ryan bursts out of his chair, screaming!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `SPICY SALSA! HOT! HOT! HOT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SPICY SALSA! HOT! HOT! HOT![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He leaps into the fountain and begins to lap up the water.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm sorry, sir... Was there a problem with your meal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dinner and a show! What's next? A wrestling match?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Yahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Keith, covered in food, scrambles to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Get out! I should have known a table with $ZOE sitting at it would be trouble!
They leave the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got the wrong guy, Howard! It was Ryan who made $ZOE cry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, I saw what I saw!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I tried to block him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe if you actually `listened` when I talked about proper blocking techniques...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if you actually [color=#e23b3b][i]listened[/i][/color] when I talked about proper blocking techniques...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, so it's my fault! I didn't exactly see you coming to the rescue!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was eating!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They `were` pretty good chips...
nodes.text_bbcode: They [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] pretty good chips...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Who's excited for... Whatever's next on the date?! I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Denni's right. Ugh. I hate that I said that. But let's just forget about this and move on...
Sam stands upright as Howard charges into her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam and Howard tumble into Keith, and the three fall into a table of food, knocking it over!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Yahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Keith, covered in food, scrambles to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Get out! I should have known a table with $ZOE sitting at it would be trouble!
They leave the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got the wrong guy, Howard! It was Ryan who made $ZOE cry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, I saw what I saw!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I tried to block him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe if you actually `listened` when I talked about proper blocking techniques...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if you actually [color=#e23b3b][i]listened[/i][/color] when I talked about proper blocking techniques...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, so it's my fault! I didn't exactly see you coming to the rescue!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was eating!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They `were` pretty good chips...
nodes.text_bbcode: They [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] pretty good chips...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Who's excited for... Whatever's next on the date?! I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Denni's right. Ugh. I hate that I said that. But let's just forget about this and move on...
Sam freezes up! Howard tackles Keith right into a table of food!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Yahhhhh!`
Keith, covered in food, scrambles to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Get out! I should have known a table with $ZOE sitting at it would be trouble!
They leave the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got the wrong guy, Howard! It was Ryan who made $ZOE cry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, I saw what I saw!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I tried to block him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe if you actually `listened` when I talked about proper blocking techniques...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, so it's my fault! I didn't exactly see you coming to the rescue!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was eating!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They `were` pretty good chips...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Who's excited for... Whatever's next on the date?! I know I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Denni's right. Ugh. I hate that I said that. But let's just forget about this and move on...
A familiar waiter approaches, holding a pen and pad.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Buenas Tardes! Welcome to Pico de...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Keith. I didn't realize you worked here...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't 'hi' me! I don't talk to someone when there's a chance they might be secretly videotaping me!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Here are your chips and salsa, `Howard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Here are your chips and salsa, [color=#e23b3b][i]Howard![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Keith marches off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be really good friends...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE...
Howard's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello? No, Kay, `don't` put any used diapers `back` on baby Kara! And tell Kel not to use `any` of my clothes again either!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello? No, Kay, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] put any used diapers [color=#e23b3b][i]back[/i][/color] on baby Kara! And tell Kel not to use [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] of my clothes again either!

nodes.text: Howard excuses himself and steps outside to deal with the call.
Just then, from across the restaurant, Ryan gets up from his table...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is everyone from Centerscore here tonight?!
Ryan sees $ZOE and makes a beeline for her.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, I've been looking for you! Jessica says you've been making out with `everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I've been looking for you! Jessica says you've been making out with [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And that I'm next in line!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I'm with Howard...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: From what I hear, that shouldn't stop you!
Sam stands up and rushes to $ZOE's defense!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She kissed `one` Italian guy months ago!
nodes.text_bbcode: She kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] Italian guy months ago!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Whoa! That explains why she's got the hots for me! I'm one-sixteenth Italian!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Sniffle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get lost, Ryan... Or Spencer will knock you into next week!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Time-travel punching!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Whatever.
Ryan slinks back to his table. A few seconds later, Keith returns...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Listen, $ZOE, I saw you crying. I just wanted to apologize... I didn't mean to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, `sniffle,` I just...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]sniffle,[/i][/color] I just...

nodes.text: Howard comes back from his call. He stops when he sees Keith hovering over $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Keith!` I told you to leave her alone! Now you've made her cry!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Keith![/i][/color] I told you to leave her alone! Now you've made her cry!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What? No! That wasn't...
Howard charges forward, running straight at Keith! Sam stands up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, no!
Sam returns to the group...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They can sit us now if we split into a group of four and a group of two. I was thinking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, look at the fountain! That's so romantic!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Why don't you and Howard sit at one of those, $ZOE? Spencer and I will sit with Ben and... And Denni.
$ZOE and Howard sit at one of the tables for two around the fountain. Sam, Spencer, Ben, and Denni sit nearby at a table for four.
Just then, Ben's alarm goes off on his watch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's official, Denni! We've been together for twenty-three days as of this second! It's our twenty-third day-a-versary!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's nauseatingly sweet, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kiss twenty-three times?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, okay! So long as it doesn't make us one of those obnoxious couples!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How could we be obnoxious when you're so cute!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Denni leans over and kisses Ben repeatedly!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugggh. Really glad you invited `them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugggh. Really glad you invited [color=#3b78e2][i]them![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't worry! I can get this conversation going all by myself!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you guys know about proper blocking technique?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I bet you didn't know the secret is to block low!
Ben and Denni continue to kiss...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is a disaster...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's probably not any better at the other table!
At Howard and $ZOE's table...
Sam returns to the group...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We have to wait...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? But I'm hungry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's okay! Spencer, why don't you tell me how you blocked that big guy in our last football game?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was easy! The trick to blocking is to get low! Otherwise, you get knocked over!
Sam pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: One nice thing about having Howard here... Spencer has someone he can talk with about football.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard too! On our last date, he quizzed me on how many receptions he had!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What'd you say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just told him he always looks cute in his uniform!
The hostess comes up to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: Good news! One of our customers just left to deliver a baby... So a table for six is available!
The group sits down at a big table for six...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is kind of fun! Usually dinner is just me eating frozen dinners in front of the TV.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Frozen pizza rules.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant like lobster or truffles.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Truffles! That's not a food!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is going well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Sorry about the mix-up with Ben and Denni. Are we cool?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry about it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not like I `planned an elaborate date for four!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not like I [color=#3b78e2][i]planned an elaborate date for four![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Good thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was being sarcastic, Spencer! For starters, I made a reservation for `four` not `six!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was being sarcastic, Spencer! For starters, I made a reservation for [color=#3b78e2][i]four[/i][/color] not [color=#3b78e2][i]six![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam walks into the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: Hola! Welcome to Pico de Salsa! Do you have a reservation?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Yes, but my party has increased by two people. Can you accommodate us?

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: Impossible, I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: Although... I still have your table `plus` another table nearby for two. Very romantic... We have a fountain!
nodes.text_bbcode: Although... I still have your table [color=#3b78e2][i]plus[/i][/color] another table nearby for two. Very romantic... We have a fountain!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you can't combine the tables?

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: Sorry, but it's a fire hazard. Muy caliente.

nodes.speaker: Hostess
nodes.text: If you wait, a table might free up for six, but no guarantees! What do you want to do?

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Gee... Thanks. I thought we were cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I thought you were trying to be nicer these days.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This `is` me being nice! How do I know she won't try to kiss Spencer when my back is turned?
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] me being nice! How do I know she won't try to kiss Spencer when my back is turned?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We were trapped in a classroom!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, so what if you and Spencer get trapped in the restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that a possibility?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easy, girls! We're all just here to have a good time, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought that was the plan.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Rocky start...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe it's time for us to figure out what 'Sam and Denni' are all about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that... A thing now?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It could be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, just... Keep your distance from me. And from Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Done and done.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least this isn't as awkward as it could have been.
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...So do you think you can come?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... It's not like anyone else at school wants to hang out with me right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry. People just love a good scandal. This cheerleading thing will blow over before you know it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll see...
And meanwhile, across town...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't believe you got around the Flaming Games firewall and downloaded 'Frogs of Destruction 7!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, it's so challenging! Thanks for coming over. I really needed some `guy time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it's so challenging! Thanks for coming over. I really needed some [color=#e23b3b][i]guy time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, Kale, Friday... Any chance you're up for a double date with me and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Let me check.
Ben turns to Denni, who is sitting next to him on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I love `guy time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I love [color=#3b78e2][i]guy time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What am I doing Friday?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Looks like you're going on a double date, Kale!
That Friday, Sam and Spencer stand outside a Mexican restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is going to be fun! Look, there are Howard and $ZOE now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Sup, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Hey, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh? What are `they` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh? What are [color=#e23b3b][i]they[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.text: From across the street, Ben and Denni approach...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There you are!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're here for the double date!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer! Did you invite Ben and Denni?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wasn't that the plan?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! We were supposed to go with $ZOE and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You said the couple we were going with was `obvious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You said the couple we were going with was [color=#e23b3b][i]obvious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I did! Why would you possibly think I was referring to Ben and Denni?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... Ben's my best friend... And you and Denni go `way` back!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Ben's my best friend... And you and Denni go [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] back!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Way back?! `Way back?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Way back?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Way back?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Denni and I...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll even plan it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! Awesome! It'll be just like tag team wrestling!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... And I think it's pretty obvious who we should double date with.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I couldn't agree more!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You do?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You do!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... What do you love about me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, uh, love your... Shoes. And your... Tackles.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How could I not love someone who tackles so much?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense. I do tackle a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't need a stupid double date... I'll learn to love Spencer on my own!
Ten years later...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: In the right corner, we have the defending champion... Surf 'n Turf Murph!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And in the left corner, we have the challenger... `Spencer 'The Pain Dispenser' Cooper!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And in the left corner, we have the challenger... [color=#e23b3b][i]Spencer 'The Pain Dispenser' Cooper![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr....
Meanwhile, in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe this is how I spend my Friday nights.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It took forty minutes just to get him into his spandex unitard.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Dispense the pain!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hit him with the 'Cooper Scooper'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm dedicating this match to my wife, Sam... And my six beautiful children!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spencerface Junior... Spence McGee... Samface Junior... Spencerina... Samface III... And Samface IV...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My life didn't have to be like this...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I should have tried out that double date...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Spencer. It's just hard for me to focus on football stuff `all` the time.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm... I'm sorry, Spencer. It's just hard for me to focus on football stuff [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you want to talk about then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... Isn't there anything else you're interested in?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's funny you ask because I just started getting into wrestling!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just finished watching the Wrestling Channel's Pinned To Your Couch marathon!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And next week, The Embalmer is going up against Surf 'N' Turf Murph!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Murph's going to give him the Lobster Claw, the Bronco Kick, `and` the Tex Mex Suplex!
nodes.text_bbcode: Murph's going to give him the Lobster Claw, the Bronco Kick, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] the Tex Mex Suplex!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh... How can you watch wrestling?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! Wrestling is `exactly` like those musicals that girls always watch...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding me?! Wrestling is [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] like those musicals that girls always watch...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Except it's the complete opposite, cause it's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The Embalmer has this one move where he takes the guy's neck and...
As Spencer demonstrates the move, he knocks over his glass, spilling soda all over...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `MY SHOES! NOOOOOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]MY SHOES! NOOOOOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've gotta get these cleaned!
Spencer runs off to the restroom!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He `really` cares about his shoes.
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] cares about his shoes.

nodes.text: From a nearby table, Hector comes over and sits in Spencer's seat.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. Fancy seeing you here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hector! Good to see you... Outside of school.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How's the date going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not well. I'm learning `way` too much about sports.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not well. I'm learning [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too much about sports.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ah, I see. A classic case of the one-sided conversation.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can I offer up a word of awesome advice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If it's awesome, how can I refuse?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You and Spencer should double date! Double dates are crazy fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `You` double date?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] double date?

nodes.text: Hector gestures over to his table where Amanda is sitting across from Maria and Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It keeps things spicy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And, uh... Conversation with Amanda is sometimes... Well... You know.
Sam and Hector overhear a snippet of conversation at the other table...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So then the kitten turned to me and said...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... What `did` it say?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... What [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] it say?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How can you not remember what a talking kitten said?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm so lost... Are we talking about a dream or not!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Double dates are relationship savers! There's less pressure on you to make conversation, it opens up a whole new can of activities, and...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If anything goes wrong, you can just blame the other couple! Boom! Scapegoats!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just make sure you're careful planning it out... Double dates can get out of hand quickly!
Hector sees Spencer emerge from the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's my cue! Think about it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I'm getting bored!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's all Jacob and Maria's fault, Manda-Panda! But don't worry, I'm coming back!
Hector gives Sam a parting wink and returns to his table...
Spencer sits back down at his seat.
